meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: Claude 拿到产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简报后,会按步骤做成产品发布/宣传视频:建项目、抓网页素材、定视觉风格、写分镜脚本,逐帧生成画面并渲染出 mp4。网站导览/展示场景下会用真实页面截图作为画面。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布或上线某个产品,或给出商业网址、要求网站导览/展示时触发;用途不明时转入 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 这个产品页做成一支发布宣传视频。
say.note: 它会先建项目、抓素材,再按流程出片。

say.text: 这是新功能的文字介绍,请做成 30 秒的发布视频。
say.note: 它会保存文字当脚本,规划分镜并逐帧渲染。

say.text: 给我们的网站做一条导览式展示视频,按页面原样呈现。
say.note: 它抓真实页面截图当画面,而不是重建整站。

howto.what_en: Claude converts a product/marketing URL, script, or brief into a launch/promo video: setup project, capture site assets, choose style, write storyboard/script, generate frames, render mp4. Site tours use real screenshots.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or supplies a commercial URL / asks for a website tour or showcase, this skill activates. If unclear, it routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this product page into a launch promo video: https://example.com
say_en.note: Creates project, captures assets, and renders video.

say_en.text: Here is the text of our new feature — make a 30-second launch video.
say_en.note: Plans shots from the text, then renders.

say_en.text: Make a site-tour showcase of our website, as it appears.
say_en.note: Uses real page screenshots, not a rebuilt site.
